name: ganttcharttool
description: Gantt Chart Tool with export capabilities for Excel, PowerPoint and PDF

scripts.package-win: npm run clean && electron-packager . "Gantt Chart Tool" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --icon=build/icon.ico --out=release-builds --overwrite --no-console --ignore="node_modules/((?!(html-pdf|exceljs|pptxgenjs|chart.js)).*)|release-builds|.git|.vscode|Output|dist|installer.iss" --prune=true
scripts.package-win-dev: npm run clean && electron-packager . "Gantt Chart Tool Dev" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --icon=build/icon.ico --out=release-builds --overwrite --ignore="node_modules|release-builds|.git|.vscode|Output|dist|installer.iss"

author: Gantt Chart Tool Team
